name: Tyrone Bryant
source:
Job: Woodworker
Skill: Hand-to-hand combat, marksmanship
Hobby: Woodworking, paintball with friends
Loves: Nature, antique woodwork, working with his hands
Pet Peeve: Being talked down to/being patronized, pretentious people

“I’d rather have one year with you than a hundred years without.”
 
Tyrone “Ty” Bryant is a stand-up, down-home kind of guy—he has a lot of common sense, and a strong sense of right and wrong. He is very down-to-earth, honest, and blunt.

[From the game's [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/characters/]website[/url]]
